meta.ref: whity-core base.json 2.0.0 + Whity brand decision register (28 Oct 2026)

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Paper. The page ground behind every surface (brand name: Paper). Neutral by rule: zero chroma, so a tenant's brand never fights an inherited tint.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text and headings on `background`, `card`, `popover` (17:1 light, 19:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surface — the blank sheet. Cards, panels, tables and form groups sit on it, raised off `background`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, tooltips and command palette.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action a view is for: filled buttons, links, active nav, selected states. White-label: tenants override this. Text on `card` 6.1:1 light, 6.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills: white in light mode (6.1:1, decision 2.1), a dark label in dark mode (6.7:1, decision 2.2).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis filled buttons and segmented controls.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table header rows, disabled fields, skeletons, hover on ghost buttons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, metadata, timestamps. #696969 = 4.7:1 on the page, 5.5:1 on cards (decision 2.6).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for menu items and toggles.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Whity Blue. The platform's own colour: the mark's substrate, the plane offset, the blueprint ground. Tenants override it alongside `primary`.

tokens.name: brand-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` fills: white in light mode, dark in dark mode.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete and irreversible actions. Same as `error` (decision 2.5a merged them).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill: badges with solid fill, buttons, progress. Label on it: `success-foreground`.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `success` fills.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill: badges with solid fill, buttons, progress. Label on it: `warning-foreground`.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `warning` fills.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error fill: badges with solid fill, buttons, progress. Label on it: `error-foreground`.

tokens.name: error-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `error` fills.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info is neutral grey (decision 2.5b): blue stays for action and brand. The icon and wording carry it.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `info` fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative edges: cards (1px, no shadow, decision 4.6a), dividers between page regions.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, outline buttons, checkboxes: 3:1 against the card (decision 2.6). Card borders stay `border`.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring, 2px offset (decision 4.6b).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1: main colour (follows primary). Categorical set (decision 2.7), colour-blind checked; ordered data uses lightness steps of the main colour.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2: amber. Categorical set (decision 2.7), colour-blind checked; ordered data uses lightness steps of the main colour.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3: sky. Categorical set (decision 2.7), colour-blind checked; ordered data uses lightness steps of the main colour.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4: plum. Categorical set (decision 2.7), colour-blind checked; ordered data uses lightness steps of the main colour.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5: green. Categorical set (decision 2.7), colour-blind checked; ordered data uses lightness steps of the main colour.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item: the tint, not a solid fill (decision 7.3).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on the active sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar divider.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: mark-sheet
tokens.usage: The mark's sheet: always white, in both themes. Used by the Mark and Lockup components.

tokens.name: blueprint
tokens.usage: Blueprint ground: Whity Blue that does not invert with the theme. Lines and text on it are white (6.1:1).

tokens.name: blueprint-line
tokens.usage: Blueprint fine grid (16px).

tokens.name: blueprint-line-strong
tokens.usage: Blueprint major grid (80px) and drawn lines.

tokens.name: plane-deep
tokens.usage: Addition (not yet in base.json). The substrate offset under a `primary`-filled button, so a blue sheet still reads as a sheet on a deeper plane. Decorative; never text.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside cards and between table rows (#ececec).

tokens.name: table-header
tokens.usage: Table header row fill (#f7f7f7).

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success as text or icon on cards and the page (≥4.5:1 on both).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success tint: alert backgrounds and tinted badges (decision 7.4), with `success-text` on it.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text or icon on cards and the page (≥4.5:1 on both).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning tint: alert backgrounds and tinted badges (decision 7.4), with `warning-text` on it.

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Error as text or icon on cards and the page (≥4.5:1 on both).

tokens.name: error-tint
tokens.usage: Error tint: alert backgrounds and tinted badges (decision 7.4), with `error-text` on it.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info as text or icon on cards and the page (≥4.5:1 on both).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info tint: alert backgrounds and tinted badges (decision 7.4), with `info-text` on it.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `destructive`.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected state fill (decision 7.3): active nav item, chosen segment. Derived from `primary` at L 0.96 (dark L 0.30).

tokens.name: primary-tint-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `primary-tint`.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Series 6: graphite. Categorical set (decision 2.7), colour-blind checked; ordered data uses lightness steps of the main colour.

families.sans: 'Noto Sans', 'Noto Sans Arabic', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
families.heading: 'Noto Sans', 'Noto Sans Arabic', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website hero, slide titles. Readex Pro 600, steps of 1.25 (decision 3.5b). Never in the product.

styles.name: display-h2
styles.usage: Brand H2 (31px); document titles at 22pt in print.

styles.name: text-lg
styles.usage: Large text: reading pages, emails, onboarding.
styles.sample: Every invoice is sent to JoFotara when you issue it.

styles.name: text
styles.usage: The default (decision 3.5a): body, table cells, inputs (= text-sm).
styles.sample: Billing assistant wants to send 3 payment reminders.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Floor: counters and tiny badges only. Nothing read below 11px.

styles.name: arabic-text
styles.usage: Arabic at the same size as Latin (decision 3.7a), taller line height (1.7 body, 1.5 labels and titles). Western digits.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Reset, flush.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Half-step: icon-to-text nudges, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base unit: small gaps, compact padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default content gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header and major section separation.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: shadcn --radius root = 9px, the 36px control (¼ rule, decision 4.2).

tokens.name: radius-control-sm
tokens.usage: 28px controls (¼ of height).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: 36px buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-control-lg
tokens.usage: 40px controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small chips inside inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menu items, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables (capped).

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, the app icon preview.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges (tinted pills), avatars, actor chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts (40px scale).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-card (Tailwind rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-dialog (Tailwind rounded-2xl).

shadow.note: The plane (hard, no blur, down-left) appears in three places only: the main button, approved agent work, a hovered clickable card (decision 4.3). Everything floating uses shadow-float. Cards have a border and no shadow.

tokens.name: plane-rest
tokens.usage: Resting substrate under sheet-coloured actions (outline buttons) and the one designated band per page.

tokens.name: plane-hover
tokens.usage: Hover lift: pair with translate 1px -1px. Clickable cards show the plane only on hover.

tokens.name: plane-primary-rest
tokens.usage: Substrate under `primary`-filled buttons (`plane-deep`).

tokens.name: plane-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover lift for `primary`-filled buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs (decision 4.4). The plane is never used for floating layers.

tokens.name: plane-offset
tokens.usage: 3px: the resting offset of the substrate.

tokens.name: plane-lift
tokens.usage: 5px: the offset on hover.

tokens.name: logo-min-mark
tokens.usage: Smallest mark (small cut); 6mm in print.

tokens.name: logo-min-horizontal
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the horizontal lockup on screen (6 mm in print), decision 1.7c.

tokens.name: logo-min-stacked
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the stacked lockup.

tokens.name: mark-cut-switch
tokens.usage: From 24px up the master mark (m = 2px); below it the 20px and 16px pixel cuts, decision 1.7a.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in toolbars and tables.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects (decision 4.1).

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons (sign-in, onboarding).

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Table rows.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon beside 14px text; stroke-width 2.25 (1.5px rendered, decision 5.2).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar; collapses to 56px below 1024px, drawer below 768px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Reading pages (decision 4.5); tables may go full width.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Forms and settings.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter desktop (16px on phones).

tokens.name: logo-clear-space
tokens.usage: Clear space around the live area: 3 m, which is 25% of the mark height, decision 1.7b.

motion.note: Decision 5.3: one ease-out curve; reduced motion shows the end state.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, button lift.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: State changes; the approve set-down is 200ms.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Things entering: dialogs, sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The only easing curve.
